title: Tonsillitis in nepali | Deepak Poudel | Doctor Sathi
description: Dr Deepak Poudel, otorhinolaryngologist working at BPKIHS explains the causes, clinical feature and management of tonsillitis in nepali. #DoctorSathi #deepak_poudel#tonsillitis

We have one that is on the nose. The other one is also in the throat. But they have to be in the side of the tongue. So, tonsils are similar to that of the tongue or tongue? We treat this disease mainly by bacteria or virus. We don't give antibiotics to the virus. We usually give an anticoagulant to the virus. We take medicines that are not dangerous.
